which shown under Section 67A of IT Act and '$' Includes All (Male&Female) Cases under Immoral Trafficking (P) Act
Note : i) * Crime Rate is not Calculated as Children's City Population is not available. TABLE 1B.5- Page 2 of 12
ii) ** Excludes POCSO Act cases as these are clubbed with IPC Sections 354, 376 and 509 etc.
Iii) Child Labour Act, ITP Act & Other Pocso Act Cases under Sec 14 & 15 are covered under 'Other SLL Crimes'
i) * includes cases registered under SC/ST (PoA) Act only. This figure does not include cases registered TABLE 1B.5- Page 3 of 12
under IPC along with SC/ST (PoA) Act as those cases have already been counted under IPC Crimes. A
detailed bifurcation is available in the Chapter 'Atrocities against SC/ST'. Col.26=Col.26A+Col.26B
ii) Crime Rate is not Calculated as SCs/STs City Population is not available. Col.27=Col.27A+Col.27B
* National Security Act has been excluded as No FIR's are registered under the Act (used only for TABLE 1B.5- Page 4 of 12
preventive detention)
Note: No Cases Reported under Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 in 19 Metropolitan TABLE 1B.5- Page 9 of 12
Cities.
Note : i) * No Cases Reported under Railway Property (Unlawful Possession) Act, 1966 TABLE 1B.5- Page 11 of 12
in 19 Metropolitan Cities. Above 2 cases under Indian Railways Act are registered by GRP
(RPF Cases are not Included here. However, RPF Cases are shown separately in Chapter 12B)
Note : * Other SLL includes cases under MV Act (FIR Registered Cases), COTPA Act, POCSO Act, Land TABLE 1B.5- Page 12 of 12
Revenue Act, Prevention of Cruelty to Animal Act, Money Lenders Act, Food Safety Standard Act,
Noise Pollution Act and Local Police Act etc.
